note: 仅文本编稿，音色待试听，音频比例未验。纠正既有p203说明：readiness失败改变就绪状态及常规Service端点资格，不直接重启容器；liveness和startup失败达到阈值才可触发容器重启。每段六引用；未来回访不计实绩。

series.title: 就绪误判：进程活着，服务端点却掉了
series.premise: checkout发布只改探针超时配置，四个副本中两个反复失去就绪资格。应用错误增加，但没有容器退出证据。
series.outcome: 同路径测试确认一秒超时过于严格，健康处理器在合法请求负载下偶尔需约一点四秒。经应用与平台授权先将一个副本恢复为原先两秒超时，验证真实流量与故障检测后逐个修复。保留依赖故障风险，补充探针分工与负载测试。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

phraseDefinitions.zh: 可接收服务流量的就绪端点
撤销端点的流量接收资格
正常状态被误判为失败
端点状态向流量路径传播
探针应检测什么的约定

recycling.note: 候选回访仅是未来排期，不是已发生复现；本稿旧表达仅来自p001-p350或本场此前段。

dialogues.title: 就绪异常，不先猜重启
dialogues.premise: 探针配置发布后四副本中两个就绪状态反复变化。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分就绪异常、错误率和待核实的进程状态。

lines.en: We've lost two ready endpoints. It's flapping after the probe change.
lines.zh: 两个就绪端点没了，探针变更后状态反复变化。

lines.en: Two out of four replicas? Are containers actually exiting, or just unready?
lines.zh: 四副本里的两个？容器真的退出了，还是只是未就绪？

lines.en: The error rate spiked. I haven't checked container exits yet.
lines.zh: 错误率陡涨了，我还没核对容器是否退出。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, scope is checkout, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，目前范围是结账服务，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, from this alert. Other services still need a separate check.
lines.zh: 这条告警是这样，其他服务还得另查。

lines.en: The changed deployment is checkout only. I'll compare status and recent events.
lines.zh: 这次只改了结账部署，我对比状态和近期事件。

lines.en: Keep the current evidence. A restart could hide the original state.
lines.zh: 保留现有证据，重启可能掩盖原始状态。

lines.en: So, what's the ETA for that comparison? About two minutes?
lines.zh: 那么，对比预计多久？两分钟左右吗？

lines.en: That should cover initial samples. It won't establish the cause yet.
lines.zh: 初步采样应该够，但还不能确定原因。

lines.en: I'll check customer failures alongside it. No application restart for now.
lines.zh: 我同时核对客户请求失败，暂不重启应用。

dialogues.title: 端点减少如何影响请求
dialogues.premise: 确认告警来自checkout；先核对真实流量与就绪端点变化。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解常规Service新流量与已有连接行为并不相同。

lines.en: Endpoint removal matches the error rise. The remaining replicas take more requests.
lines.zh: 端点撤出与错误上涨时间吻合，剩余副本接了更多请求。

lines.en: Do we know the routing behavior? Existing connections might behave differently.
lines.zh: 知道路由行为了吗？已有连接可能表现不同。

lines.en: This Service uses ready endpoints normally. Unready replicas stop receiving new routed traffic.
lines.zh: 这个Service正常使用就绪端点，未就绪副本不再接收新路由流量。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, existing connections aren't automatically killed, right?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，已有连接不会因此自动被杀掉，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Endpoint updates don't guarantee immediate changes on every traffic path.
lines.zh: 对，端点更新不保证每条流量路径立即变化。

lines.en: That's our blast radius from current logs. Roughly three percent of requests fail.
lines.zh: 当前日志显示的影响范围就是这些请求，约百分之三失败。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on routing. Separate failures from slow successful requests.
lines.zh: 我关注路由，分开统计失败和慢但成功的请求。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is probe misjudgment. We still need application evidence.
lines.zh: 当前假设是探针误判，但还需要应用证据。

lines.en: Don't equate a healthy process with readiness. Dependencies could still prevent service.
lines.zh: 不要把进程正常等同于就绪，依赖故障仍可能使服务不可用。

lines.en: So, check exits and dependency results next. Keep that distinction in our update.
lines.zh: 那么，接下来查退出和依赖结果，更新里保留这个区分。

dialogues.title: 未重启，不等于一定可服务
dialogues.premise: 端点撤出关联错误上涨，但探针误判尚未得到直接证据。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出readiness与liveness职责，及零重启能排除什么。

lines.en: The restart count hasn't changed. The liveness probe stayed successful throughout.
lines.zh: 重启计数没变，存活探针一直成功。

lines.en: Then readiness didn't restart anything. It controls readiness, not container restart policy.
lines.zh: 所以readiness没有重启任何东西，它控制就绪，不控制容器重启策略。

lines.en: Let me tail the log. No exits, and sampled dependency calls succeed.
lines.zh: 我盯一下日志，没有退出，抽样依赖调用也成功。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, we can rule that out as repeated exits, right?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，可以排除反复退出，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, in this interval. That doesn't prove every request can complete.
lines.zh: 这个时段可以，但不能证明所有请求都能完成。

lines.en: I said it caused restarts earlier. Correction: it removed readiness, not running containers.
lines.zh: 我之前说它造成重启，纠正一下：它撤销就绪，不会移除正在运行的容器。

lines.en: Good correction. Repeated liveness failures can restart a container after its threshold.
lines.zh: 这个纠正很重要，liveness连续失败达到阈值才可能重启容器。

lines.en: Maybe the readiness probe is too aggressive. I'll time the same health handler.
lines.zh: 可能就绪探针太严格了，我测同一个健康处理器的耗时。

lines.en: Use the kubelet path too. Local tests might miss a path-specific problem.
lines.zh: 也测kubelet走的路径，本地测试可能遗漏路径特有问题。

lines.en: So, compare both paths under current load. Don't change the evidence yet.
lines.zh: 那么，在当前负载下比较两条路径，先不改变现场。

dialogues.title: 一秒与两秒的差别
dialogues.premise: 无容器退出，liveness正常；开始对比部署前后有效探针配置。
dialogues.listeningTask: 抓住唯一变化项，而不是将所有阈值一起调整。

lines.en: The probe timeout changed from two seconds. It's one second now.
lines.zh: 探针超时从两秒改成了现在的一秒。

lines.en: Only readiness changed? Compare the effective spec against the last revision.
lines.zh: 只改了readiness？把生效配置与上一版对比。

lines.en: Yes, path and failure count stayed unchanged. The liveness probe uses its separate handler.
lines.zh: 是的，路径和失败次数没变，存活探针仍用单独的处理器。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, no application release, right? This was configuration only.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，没发布应用版本，对吧？这次只有配置。

lines.en: Correct, the image digest matches. Check request load before blaming the timeout.
lines.zh: 对，镜像摘要一致，但归咎于超时前还要核对请求负载。

lines.en: I'm on it. Managed configuration records both revisions and the approval.
lines.zh: 我来查，统一配置管理记录了两版配置和审批。

lines.en: The handler sometimes takes about fourteen hundred milliseconds. That's above one second.
lines.zh: 处理器有时花约一千四百毫秒，超过一秒。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis fits those samples. But timing alone doesn't establish service health.
lines.zh: 当前假设符合这些样本，但仅耗时不能证明服务健康。

lines.en: Exactly. Pair each slow probe with application and dependency outcomes.
lines.zh: 正是如此，把每次慢探针与应用和依赖结果对应起来。

lines.en: So, retain both revisions for review. We'll decide after that paired comparison.
lines.zh: 那么，保留两版配置供评审，完成对应比较后再决定。

dialogues.title: 误判有证据，但不能关探针
dialogues.premise: 仅readiness超时由两秒降至一秒，慢探针样本正在关联业务结果。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出误判的证据范围、批准的修复和不能采取的捷径。

lines.en: These samples show a false negative. The handler completes successfully after one second.
lines.zh: 这些样本显示误判，处理器在一秒后成功完成。

lines.en: And matching application requests succeed. We reproduced it under representative load.
lines.zh: 对应的应用请求也成功了，在代表性负载下复现了问题。

lines.en: The old probe timeout covers those samples. Restoring it should buy us time.
lines.zh: 原先超时覆盖这些样本，恢复原值应能争取时间。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, restore two seconds, right? Not disable readiness entirely.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，恢复两秒，对吧？不是彻底关闭readiness。

lines.en: Disabling it could route traffic to unhealthy replicas. What's the rollback trigger?
lines.zh: 关闭可能把流量发给不健康副本，回退触发条件是什么？

lines.en: Higher customer failures mean stop expansion. Failed health detection means stop too.
lines.zh: 客户失败增多就停止扩大，健康故障检测失效也要停。

lines.en: Test dependency failure in staging. Don't inject that failure into production now.
lines.zh: 在预发布测试依赖失败，现在不要向生产注入这个故障。

lines.en: Maybe increase every threshold? No, let's park that. One variable makes comparison clearer.
lines.zh: 要不要把所有阈值都提高？不，先搁置，单变量更便于比较。

lines.en: I agree with the narrow change. Check replacement capacity before approving the canary.
lines.zh: 我同意窄范围变更，批准灰度前先查替换容量。

lines.en: So, approval covers one replica initially. Raj owns execution; Hannah owns validation.
lines.zh: 那么，先批准一个副本，Raj执行，Hannah验收。

dialogues.title: 替换副本与额外就绪条件
dialogues.premise: 批准先恢复一个副本的两秒超时，已确认替换容量。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分探针成功与Pod整体就绪，并听清变更范围。

lines.en: The staged rollout replaced one replica. Its probe timeout now allows two seconds.
lines.zh: 分阶段发布替换了一个副本，它的探针超时现在允许两秒。

lines.en: Any additional readiness gate? Probe success alone might not make it ready.
lines.zh: 有没有额外就绪门槛？探针成功不一定代表整个Pod就绪。

lines.en: No custom readiness gate here. All container readiness conditions are now satisfied.
lines.zh: 这里没有自定义就绪门槛，所有容器就绪条件现在都满足了。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, one replacement only, right? No wider rollout yet.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，只替换一个，对吧？还没扩大发布。

lines.en: Right. Let's keep it under observation. Check actual Service traffic as well.
lines.zh: 对，保持观察，也检查真实Service流量。

lines.en: I'm on it. Customer request samples are successful on that new replica.
lines.zh: 我来查，这个新副本上的客户请求样本成功。

lines.en: Don't count only synthetic successes. Compare errors and latency with untouched replicas.
lines.zh: 不要只数模拟请求成功，对比未变副本的错误和延迟。

lines.en: So, maybe ten minutes of comparison. Keep the deployment paused meanwhile.
lines.zh: 那么，先比较十分钟左右，期间继续暂停扩大部署。

lines.en: Staging still rejects the broken dependency. Detection remains within our agreed window.
lines.zh: 预发布仍能拒绝坏依赖，检测时间还在约定窗口内。

lines.en: I'll attach that evidence to approval. Probe success isn't our only acceptance check.
lines.zh: 我把证据附在审批里，探针成功不是唯一验收项。

dialogues.title: 端点就绪后流量是否到达
dialogues.premise: 灰度副本探针与整体就绪均通过，预发布依赖故障检测有效。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听清状态传播、真实流量与恢复宣告的先后顺序。

lines.en: Endpoint propagation is visible now. The gateway is sending new requests there.
lines.zh: 现在看到端点状态传播了，网关正往那里发送新请求。

lines.en: Three ready endpoints remain stable. The unchanged fourth replica still drops readiness.
lines.zh: 三个就绪端点保持稳定，未修改的第四个副本仍掉就绪。

lines.en: That comparison supports the fix. Is request load comparable across replicas?
lines.zh: 这个对照支持修复判断，各副本请求负载可比吗？

lines.en: Yes, roughly comparable in this window. No false negative on the changed replica.
lines.zh: 这个窗口里大致可比，修改副本没有出现误判。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, don't say we're back to baseline yet, right?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，还不能说回到基线，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Aggregate latency remains slightly high. The remaining replicas still carry extra load.
lines.zh: 对，总体延迟仍略高，剩余副本仍承担额外负载。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on endpoint changes. We need stability before expanding anything.
lines.zh: 我持续关注端点变化，扩大前必须稳定。

lines.en: Check failure detection evidence too. More endpoints alone isn't proof of correctness.
lines.zh: 也检查故障检测证据，端点更多本身不能证明正确。

lines.en: Staging evidence is attached already. Production requests and dependency samples look healthy.
lines.zh: 预发布证据已经附上，生产请求和依赖样本看起来正常。

lines.en: So, prepare the next reviewed batch. We'll restore the rest one by one.
lines.zh: 那么，准备下一批评审，逐个恢复其余副本。

dialogues.title: 只恢复超时，不顺手改阈值
dialogues.premise: 灰度证据支持修复，但第四副本仍未就绪，总体延迟还未恢复。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别审批范围和避免同时调整多个探针参数的理由。

lines.en: The failure threshold stays at three. We're restoring only the probe timeout.
lines.zh: 失败次数阈值仍是三，只恢复探针超时。

lines.en: Why not allow more failed checks? Would that reduce the remaining noise?
lines.zh: 为什么不允许更多次失败？会不会减少剩余噪声？

lines.en: It might, but delays real failure detection. We haven't tested that trade yet.
lines.zh: 可能会，但会延迟真实故障检测，还没测试这个取舍。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, timeout change only, right? That's the reviewed scope.
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，只改超时，对吧？这才是评审范围。

lines.en: Agreed. Keep the same rollback trigger. Stop if customer failures rise.
lines.zh: 同意，保留相同回退触发条件，客户失败上升就停。

lines.en: I'm on it through managed configuration. The next replacement is ready now.
lines.zh: 我通过统一配置执行，下一个替换副本现在就绪。

lines.en: Its traffic checks pass as well. Continue only after each replacement stabilizes.
lines.zh: 它的流量检查也通过了，每个替换稳定后再继续。

lines.en: So, about five minutes between replacements. I'll compare customer errors each time.
lines.zh: 那么，替换之间约五分钟，我每次都比较客户错误。

lines.en: The remaining revisions are now corrected. All four replicas have the approved timeout.
lines.zh: 剩余版本现在都纠正了，四个副本都是批准的超时。

lines.en: Keep the incident open for observation. Configuration completion isn't service acceptance yet.
lines.zh: 故障继续开放观察，配置完成还不等于服务验收。

dialogues.title: 启动期间另有探针职责
dialogues.premise: 四副本均恢复两秒超时，进入全服务稳定观察。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解startup如何影响其他探针启动，以及恢复与永久改进的区别。

lines.en: We're back to baseline for twenty minutes. The mitigation is holding across replicas.
lines.zh: 已经回到基线二十分钟，所有副本的缓解持续有效。

lines.en: All four endpoints remain stable. No rising errors or hidden dependency failures.
lines.zh: 四个端点保持稳定，没有错误上涨，也没发现隐藏依赖故障。

lines.en: The startup probe passed on replacements. It protects their initialization window.
lines.zh: 替换副本的启动探针通过了，它保护初始化窗口。

lines.en: Okay, just to confirm, readiness waits for startup success here, right?
lines.zh: 好，确认一下，这里readiness要等启动成功，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, the liveness probe waits too. Startup failures reaching its threshold can restart containers.
lines.zh: 对，存活探针也等，startup失败达到阈值可能重启容器。

lines.en: That's different from readiness failure. Our running replicas weren't repeatedly restarting earlier.
lines.zh: 这与readiness失败不同，之前运行副本没有反复重启。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation. Startup success doesn't guarantee later dependency health.
lines.zh: 继续观察，启动成功不保证后续依赖一直健康。

lines.en: So, maybe another thirty minutes. I'll keep probe and request signals together.
lines.zh: 那么，再观察三十分钟左右，我一起监控探针和请求信号。

lines.en: Record the recovered interval clearly. We still owe a durable handler review.
lines.zh: 清楚记录恢复时段，我们仍欠长期处理器评审。

lines.en: I'll report recovery, not permanent prevention. We'll assign that review next.
lines.zh: 我报告恢复，不宣称永久预防，接下来指派评审。

dialogues.title: 把探针职责写进规范
dialogues.premise: 服务稳定恢复，超时误判证据已确认，需安排长期探针设计与测试。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出技术原因、规范任务和仍未证实的流程原因。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, one second caused this false negative. Release review missed it.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，一秒超时造成这次误判，发布评审漏掉了。

lines.en: We know the technical cause. Why review missed it still needs investigation.
lines.zh: 技术原因已知，评审为什么漏掉仍需调查。

lines.en: First action item: define the probe contract. I'll own application semantics by Friday.
lines.zh: 第一项任务是定义探针契约，我周五前负责应用语义。

lines.en: Include representative load and dependency failures. Test detection timing, not just successful responses.
lines.zh: 包含代表性负载和依赖失败，测故障检测时间，不只测成功响应。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for platform checks? I'll verify startup and liveness separation.
lines.zh: 平台检查谁来接？我验证startup和liveness的分工。

lines.en: Readiness doesn't restart containers, right? Put that correction in the runbook itself.
lines.zh: readiness不会重启容器，对吧？把这个纠正写进运行手册。

lines.en: I'll review failure thresholds with Raj. Increasing them needs detection-window evidence.
lines.zh: 我和Raj评审失败阈值，提高它们必须有检测窗口证据。

lines.en: So, about one week for handler tests. We'll track results before another tightening.
lines.zh: 那么，处理器测试约一周，下次收紧前跟踪结果。

lines.en: I'll review the paired traffic evidence. Endpoint counts alone won't pass acceptance.
lines.zh: 我评审配对流量证据，仅端点数量不能通过验收。

lines.en: We'll close the loop with that record. Recovery is done; prevention work stays assigned.
lines.zh: 我们带着记录闭环，恢复完成，预防工作继续有负责人。
